44736-slavery.title: Slavery.
44736-slavery.creator: Unknown
44736-slavery.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Whoever places this faith in the everlasting law of rectitude must of course regard the question of slavery first and chiefly as a moral question. All other considerations will weigh little with him, compared with its moral character and moral influences. The following remarks, therefore, are designed to aid the reader in forming a just moral judgment of slavery.

arxiv-2012-09344.title: Machine Learning for Detecting Data Exfiltration: A Review
arxiv-2012-09344.creator: Bushra Sabir 1 2, Faheem Ullah 1, M. Ali Babar 1 3, Raj Gaire 2
arxiv-2012-09344.description: Abstract Context : Research at the intersection of cybersecurity, Machine Learning (ML), and Software Engineering (SE) has recently taken significant steps in proposing countermeasures for detecting sophisticated data exfiltration attacks. It is important to systematically review and synthesize the ML-based data exfiltration countermeasures for building a body of knowledge on this important topic.

arxiv-2103-09394.title: Investigating X-ray sources during the epoch of reionization with the 21 cm signal
arxiv-2103-09394.creator: Qing-Bo Ma, Benedetta Ciardi, Marius B. Eide, Philipp Busch, Yi Mao, Qi-Jun Zhi
arxiv-2103-09394.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Qing-Bo Ma, Benedetta Ciardi, Marius B. Eide, Philipp Busch, Yi Mao, Qi-Jun Zhi. Heating of neutral gas by energetic sources is crucial for the prediction of the 21 cm signal during the epoch of reionization (EoR).

arxiv-2104-06756.title: A Survey of the Hadamard Maximal Determinant Problem
arxiv-2104-06756.creator: Patrick Browne Ronan Egan Fintan Hegarty Padraig Ó Catháin
arxiv-2104-06756.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Patrick Browne Ronan Egan Fintan Hegarty Padraig Ó Catháin. In a celebrated paper of 1893, Hadamard proved the maximal determinant theorem, which establishes an upper bound on the determinant of a matrix with complex entries of norm at most 1 1 . His paper concludes with the suggestion that mathematicians study the maximum value of the determinant of an n × n n\times n matrix with entries in { ± 1 } \{\pm 1\} . This is the Hadamard maximal determinant problem.

arxiv-2208-04924.title: On the Activation Function Dependence of the Spectral Bias of Neural Networks
arxiv-2208-04924.creator: Qingguo Hong, Jonathan W. Siegel, Qinyang Tan, Jinchao Xu
arxiv-2208-04924.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Qingguo Hong, Jonathan W. Siegel, Qinyang Tan, Jinchao Xu. Neural networks are universal function approximators which are known to generalize well despite being dramatically overparameterized. We study this phenomenon from the point of view of the spectral bias of neural networks. Our contributions are two-fold. First, we provide a theoretical explanation for the spectral bias of ReLU neural networks by leveraging connections with the theory of finite element methods.

arxiv-2302-01638.title: Acyclic Chromatic Index of Chordless Graphs
arxiv-2302-01638.creator: Manu Basavaraju, Suresh Manjanath Hegde, Shashanka Kulamarva
arxiv-2302-01638.description: Abstract An acyclic edge coloring of a graph is a proper edge coloring in which there are no bichromatic cycles. The acyclic chromatic index of a graph G G denoted by a ′ ​ ( G ) a^{\prime}(G) , is the minimum positive integer k k such that G G has an acyclic edge coloring with k k colors.

arxiv-2308-05449.title: Transforming Breast Cancer Diagnosis: Towards Real-Time Ultrasound to Mammogram Conversion for Cost-Effective Diagnosis Journal: Ultrasonics
arxiv-2308-05449.creator: Sahar Almahfouz Nasser, Ashutosh Sharma, Anmol Saraf, Amruta Mahendra Parulekar, Purvi Haria, Amit Sethi
arxiv-2308-05449.description: Abstract Ultrasound (US) imaging is better suited for intra-operative settings because it is real-time and more portable than other imaging techniques, such as mammography. However, US images are characterized by lower spatial resolution noise-like artifacts. This research aims to address these limitations by providing surgeons with mammogram-like image quality in real-time from noisy US images.

arxiv-2310-07031.title: Rate Adaptation Aware Positioning for Flying Gateways using Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2310-07031.creator: Gabriella Pantaleão, Rúben Queirós, Hélder Fontes, Rui Campos
arxiv-2310-07031.description: Abstract With the growing connectivity demands, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have emerged as a prominent component in the deployment of Next Generation On-demand Wireless Networks. However, current UAV positioning solutions typically neglect the impact of Rate Adaptation (RA) algorithms or simplify its effect by considering ideal and non-implementable RA algorithms.

arxiv-2311-04927.title: Contextualizing the Limits of Model & Evaluation Dataset Curation on Semantic Similarity Classification Tasks
arxiv-2311-04927.creator: Daniel Theron
arxiv-2311-04927.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Daniel Theron. This paper demonstrates how the limitations of pre-trained models and open evaluation datasets factor into assessing the performance of binary semantic similarity classification tasks. As (1) end-user-facing documentation around the curation of these datasets and pre-trained model training regimes is often not easily accessible and (2) given the lower friction and higher demand to quickly deploy such systems in real-world contexts, our study reinforces prior work showing performance disparities across datasets, embedding techniques and distance metrics, while highlighting the importance of understanding

arxiv-2404-12235.title: Beyond Average: Individualized Visual Scanpath Prediction
arxiv-2404-12235.creator: Xianyu Chen, Ming Jiang, Qi Zhao
arxiv-2404-12235.description: Abstract Understanding how attention varies across individuals has significant scientific and societal impacts. However, existing visual scanpath models treat attention uniformly, neglecting individual differences. To bridge this gap, this paper focuses on individualized scanpath prediction (ISP), a new attention modeling task that aims to accurately predict how different individuals shift their attention in diverse visual tasks.

arxiv-2409-16454.title: Pulse Shaping Strategies for Efficient Switching of Magnetic Tunnel Junctions by Spin-Orbit Torque
arxiv-2409-16454.creator: Marco Hoffmann, Viola Krizakova, Vaishnavi Kateel, Kaiming Cai, Sebastien Couet, Pietro Gambardella
arxiv-2409-16454.description: Abstract The writing energy for reversing the magnetization of the free layer in a magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ) is a key figure of merit for comparing the performances of magnetic random access memories with competing technologies. Magnetization switching of MTJs induced by spin torques typically relies on square voltage pulses.

arxiv-2504-20565.title: DLCM: a versatile multi-level solver for heterogeneous multicellular systems
arxiv-2504-20565.creator: Erik Blom, Stefan Engblom
arxiv-2504-20565.description: Abstract Computational modeling of multicellular systems may aid in untangling cellular dynamics and emergent properties of biological cell populations. A key challenge is to balance the level of model detail and the computational efficiency, while using physically interpretable parameters to facilitate meaningful comparisons with biological data.

arxiv-2505-08254.title: Efficient, simulation-free estimators of firing rates with Markovian surrogates
arxiv-2505-08254.creator: Zhongyi Wang, Louis Tao, Zhuo-Cheng Xiao
arxiv-2505-08254.description: Abstract Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are powerful mathematical models that integrate the biological details of neural systems, but their complexity often makes them computationally expensive and analytically untractable. The firing rate of an SNN is a crucial first-order statistic to characterize network activity.

arxiv-2507-09462.title: MobiWorld: World Models for Mobile Wireless Network
arxiv-2507-09462.creator: Haoye Chai, Yuan Yuan, Yong Li
arxiv-2507-09462.description: Abstract Accurate modeling and simulation of mobile networks are essential for enabling intelligent and cost-effective network optimization. In this paper, we propose MobiWorld, a generative world model designed to support high-fidelity and flexible environment simulation for mobile network planning and optimization.

arxiv-2509-06065.title: KatotohananQA: Evaluating Truthfulness of Large Language Models in Filipino
arxiv-2509-06065.creator: Lorenzo Alfred Nery, Ronald Dawson Catignas, Thomas James Tiam-Lee
arxiv-2509-06065.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across various tasks, but their tendency to produce hallucinations limits reliable adoption. Benchmarks such as TruthfulQA have been developed to measure truthfulness, yet they are primarily available in English, leaving a gap in evaluating LLMs in low-resource languages. To address this, we present KatotohananQA , a Filipino translation of the TruthfulQA benchmark.

arxiv-2511-21025.title: CaptionQA: Is Your Caption as Useful as the Image Itself?
arxiv-2511-21025.creator: Shijia Yang, Yunong Liu, Bohan Zhai, Ximeng Sun, Zicheng Liu, Emad Barsoum, Manling Li, Chenfeng Xu
arxiv-2511-21025.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shijia Yang, Yunong Liu, Bohan Zhai, Ximeng Sun, Zicheng Liu, Emad Barsoum, Manling Li, Chenfeng Xu. Image captions serve as efficient surrogates for visual content in multimodal systems such as retrieval, recommendation, and multi-step agentic inference pipelines. Yet current evaluation practices miss a fundamental question: Can captions stand-in for images in real downstream tasks? We propose a utility-based benchmark, CaptionQA , to evaluate model-generated captions, where caption quality is measured by how well it supports downstream tasks.

plos-pone-0001473.title: Differential Phagocytosis of White versus Opaque Candida albicans by Drosophila and Mouse Phagocytes
plos-pone-0001473.creator: Matthew B. Lohse, Alexander D. Johnson
plos-pone-0001473.description: PLOS ONE research article. The human fungal pathogen Candida albicans resides asymptomatically in the gut of most healthy people but causes serious invasive diseases in immunocompromised patients. Many C. albicans strains have the ability to stochastically switch between distinct white and opaque cell type

pmc-11348434.title: Clinical and cognitive outcomes in first-episode psychosis: focus on the interplay between cannabis use and genetic variability in endocannabinoid receptors
pmc-11348434.creator: Maitane Oscoz-Irurozqui, Maria Guardiola-Ripoll, Carmen Almodóvar-Payá, Amalia Guerrero-Pedraza, Noemí Hostalet, María Isabel Carrion, Salvador Sarró, JJ Gomar, Edith Pomarol-Clotet, Mar Fatjó-Vilas
pmc-11348434.description: IntroductionResearch data show the impact of the endocannabinoid system on psychosis through its neurotransmission homeostatic functions. However, the effect of the endocannabinoid system genetic variability on the relationship between cannabis use and psychosis has been unexplored, even less in first-episode patients.

pmc-11429197.title: Exploring Constraints and Sport Experiences: A Case Study of Adult Workers in Singapore
pmc-11429197.creator: Heetae Cho, Ghazanfar Ali Abbasi, Hyoung-Kil Kang, Ye Hoon Lee, Víctor Arufe-Giráldez, Josune Rodríguez-Negro
pmc-11429197.description: Although rapid economic growth can produce various positive outcomes, the fast-paced society that inevitably accompanies it often results in longer working hours and higher stress levels, leading to reduced participation in sport activities among employees. To better understand this phenomenon, we aimed to explore the constraints and experiences of adult workers.

pmc-12473863.title: Integrating Experimental Toxicology and Machine Learning to Model Levonorgestrel-Induced Oxidative Damage in Zebrafish
pmc-12473863.creator: İlknur Meriç Turgut, Melek Yapıcı, Dilara Gerdan Koc, Alla P Toropova
pmc-12473863.description: Levonorgestrel (LNG), a synthetic progestin widely used in pharmaceuticals, is increasingly recognized as an emerging aquatic contaminant capable of exerting adverse biological effects beyond endocrine disruption. Acting in a xenobiotic-like manner, LNG may perturb redox homeostasis and induce oxidative stress in non-target species.

pmc-12604513.title: Development and Validation of a Predictive Model for HBsAg Seroclearance After Peg-IFN-Based Therapy: A Multicentre Study
pmc-12604513.creator: Hui-Hui Liu, Xue-Mei Jiang, Chao Cui, Jing Zhao, Juan Xu, Si-Kui Wang, Lei-Hua Hu, Yan-Ping Yin, Xiao Wang, Li-Jun Yu, Cheng Xu, Zheng-Hua Zhao, Yan-Qing Xing, Yue Liu, Kai Wang, Shuai Gao
pmc-12604513.description: PurposeEarly prediction of HBsAg seroclearance prior to the application of Peg-IFN-based therapy has important clinical implications. This study aims to construct a predictive model with baseline parameters for HBsAg seroclearance after Peg-IFN-based therapy in virally suppressed patients with HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B (CHB).

pmc-12967722.title: In Situ EC‐EPR Spectroscopy and DFT Analysis of HUPD on Polycrystalline Pt
pmc-12967722.creator: Rainer Götz, Kimmo Pyyhtiä, Bingxin Li, Theophilus K. Sarpey, Kun‐Ting Song, Mira Todorova, Nadezhda Kukharchyk, Siegfried Schreier, Pekka Peljo, Elena L. Gubanova, Jörg Neugebauer, Aliaksandr S. Bandarenka
pmc-12967722.description: Electrochemical hydrogen production and conversion using renewable energy sources have become a key topic in catalysis research. Platinum and Pt‐group metals are among the best materials promoting H2 evolution (HER) and oxidation (HOR) reactions. However, the nature of active surface sites should be further elucidated to improve their performance and gain a better fundamental understanding of those processes.

pmc-13136383.title: Topologically reconstructing Pancharatnam-Berry phase via encircling exceptional point for chiral spin-orbit interaction steering
pmc-13136383.creator: Qinghong Lyu, Qiuchen Yan, Wenjuan Zhao, Saisai Chu, Xiaoyong Hu, Qihuang Gong
pmc-13136383.description: Photonic spin-orbit interaction (SOI) is related to Pancharatnam-Berry (PB) phase, which is usually imposed on the cross-polarized components of light incident on a metasurface in broadband manner. However, metasurfaces exhibiting exceptional points (EPs) can block the cross-polarization conversion channel, hinting at the possibility of EPs influencing SOI.

pmc-13489399.title: Navigating pelvic anatomy for exenteration: a clinical guide for radiologists
pmc-13489399.creator: Stephanie Nougaret, Verity Wood, Phillipe Rouanet, Arend G J Aalbers, Tamara Glyn, Damian Tolan, Doenja M J Lambregts
pmc-13489399.description: Pelvic exenteration (PE) is a complex, potentially curative option for locally advanced or recurrent pelvic malignancies in which achieving an R0 margin is paramount. This clinical review provides a pragmatic, anatomy-driven framework to optimize preoperative assessment and multidisciplinary planning. Using a compartment-based schema—central, anterior, posterior, and lateral—the article maps tumor spread to structures that determine technical feasibility and functional outcomes.

pmc-13618225.title: USP10 stabilizes FOXM1 through KAT5-mediated acetylation to suppress cell senescence and promote melanoma malignant progression
pmc-13618225.creator: Zhiyuan Qiu, Chenglian Sun, Juan Wang, Dapeng Liang, Shang Wang, Lili Tian, Tongde Du, Chuanchun Han
pmc-13618225.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The ubiquitin signaling cascade plays a pivotal role in multiple cancer types, yet its role in melanoma progression remains incompletely elucidated. An unbiased and systematic analysis indicates that Ubiquitin-specific peptidase 10 (USP10), a member of USP gene family, was top priority prognostic signature for primary and metastatic melanoma progression-free survival and silencing USP10 markedly impairs the growth and metastatic potential of melanoma cells. We further uncover Forkhead box M1 (FOXM1) as a novel substrate of USP10.
